recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current spec satisfies the older FHIR-13316 quoting intent with the current FHIRPath-aligned delimiter; restoring double-quote delimited identifiers would need a new FHIR-I decision.
issue_request: FHIR-13316 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked that FHIR Mapping Language field/property names be quotable when they contain characters that would otherwise be interpreted as keywords or operators, such as observation-geneticsGene.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 12859. Git commit dcf8318b0b85b7d09665b779cfb85d7fb33f5b99 applied that revision to source/mapping-language.html by extending the source element description so names with non-valid identifier characters could be quoted.
additional_context: Later Published mapping-language issues changed the delimiter interpretation: FHIR-25286 and FHIR-39282 removed double quotes as delimited identifiers to harmonize with FHIRPath, and FHIR-25266 clarified that map-defined group/rule/variable names are id-constrained while source/target data model path elements may be delimited. Those related issues are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/mapping-language.html now states that source and target data model elements used in rule paths may be surrounded with backticks, and images/mapping.g4 allows DELIMITEDIDENTIFIER in qualified rule-path parts while defining that token with backticks.

related_jiras.note: Published issue that removed double quotes as mapping-language delimited identifiers to align with FHIRPath; already represented on the combined branch.
Later Published technical correction applied the grammar-level backtick-only delimiter conclusion; already represented on the combined branch.
Published issue distinguishing id-constrained map-defined names from delimited source/target data model rule-path elements; already represented on the combined branch.
